NLnet

Submit a proposal

NLnet offers funding to researchers and developers of free and open source technology.

Deadline

The next deadline for proposals is October 1st 2026 12:00 CEST. Proposals received after the deadline are considered in the next round.

Who can apply

Individuals as well as organisations and companies can apply, from anywhere in the world.

All project outcomes must be published under a free and open source licence.

Projects must have a clear European dimension.

You can request an amount between 5000 and 50000 euro for a first proposal.
